
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/DashVector/p/19143141" title="发布于 2025-10-15 13:41">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">如何通过Python SDK在Collection中进行相似性检索</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>本文介绍如何通过Python SDK在Collection中按分组进行相似性检索。</p>
<h2 id="前提条件">前提条件</h2>
<ul>
<li>已创建Cluster</li>
<li>已获得API-KEY</li>
<li>已安装最新版SDK</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="接口定义">接口定义</h2>
<p>Python示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">Collection.query_group_by(
        self,
        vector: Optional[Union[List[Union[int, float]], np.ndarray]] = None,
        *,
        group_by_field: str,
        group_count: int = 10,
        group_topk: int = 10,
        id: Optional[str] = None,
        filter: Optional[str] = None,
        include_vector: bool = False,
        partition: Optional[str] = None,
        output_fields: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        sparse_vector: Optional[Dict[int, float]] = None,
        async_req: bool = False,
    ) -&gt; DashVectorResponse:
</code></pre>
<h2 id="使用示例"><strong>使用示例</strong></h2>
<p><strong>说明</strong></p>
<p>需要使用您的api-key替换示例中的YOUR_API_KEY、您的Cluster Endpoint替换示例中的YOUR_CLUSTER_ENDPOINT，代码才能正常运行。</p>
<p>Python示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">import dashvector
import numpy as np

client = dashvector.Client(
    api_key='YOUR_API_KEY',
    endpoint='YOUR_CLUSTER_ENDPOINT'
)
ret = client.create(
    name='group_by_demo',
    dimension=4,
    fields_schema={'document_id': str, 'chunk_id': int}
)
assert ret

collection = client.get(name='group_by_demo')

ret = collection.insert([
    ('1', np.random.rand(4), {'document_id': 'paper-01', 'chunk_id': 1, 'content': 'xxxA'}),
    ('2', np.random.rand(4), {'document_id': 'paper-01', 'chunk_id': 2, 'content': 'xxxB'}),
    ('3', np.random.rand(4), {'document_id': 'paper-02', 'chunk_id': 1, 'content': 'xxxC'}),
    ('4', np.random.rand(4), {'document_id': 'paper-02', 'chunk_id': 2, 'content': 'xxxD'}),
    ('5', np.random.rand(4), {'document_id': 'paper-02', 'chunk_id': 3, 'content': 'xxxE'}),
    ('6', np.random.rand(4), {'document_id': 'paper-03', 'chunk_id': 1, 'content': 'xxxF'}),
])
assert ret
</code></pre>
<h3 id="根据向量进行分组相似性检索"><strong>根据向量进行分组相似性检索</strong></h3>
<p>Python示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">ret = collection.query_group_by(
    vector=[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4],
    group_by_field='document_id',  # 按document_id字段的值分组
    group_count=2,  # 返回2个分组
    group_topk=2,   # 每个分组最多返回2个doc
)
# 判断是否成功
if ret:
    print('query_group_by success')
    print(len(ret))
    print('------------------------')
    for group in ret:
        print('group key:', group.group_id)
        for doc in group.docs:
            prefix = ' -'
            print(prefix, doc)
</code></pre>
<p>参考输出如下</p>
<pre><code class="language-plaintext">query_group_by success
4
------------------------
group key: paper-01
 - {"id": "2", "fields": {"document_id": "paper-01", "chunk_id": 2, "content": "xxxB"}, "score": 0.6807}
 - {"id": "1", "fields": {"document_id": "paper-01", "chunk_id": 1, "content": "xxxA"}, "score": 0.4289}
group key: paper-02
 - {"id": "3", "fields": {"document_id": "paper-02", "chunk_id": 1, "content": "xxxC"}, "score": 0.6553}
 - {"id": "5", "fields": {"document_id": "paper-02", "chunk_id": 3, "content": "xxxE"}, "score": 0.4401}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="根据主键对应的向量进行分组相似性检索"><strong>根据主键对应的向量进行分组相似性检索</strong></h3>
<p>Python示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">ret = collection.query_group_by(
    id='1',
    group_by_field='name',
)
# 判断query接口是否成功
if ret:
    print('query_group_by success')
    print(len(ret))
    for group in ret:
        print('group:', group.group_id)
        for doc in group.docs:
            print(doc)
            print(doc.id)
            print(doc.vector)
            print(doc.fields)
</code></pre>
<h3 id="带过滤条件的分组相似性检索"><strong>带过滤条件的分组相似性检索</strong></h3>
<p>Python示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"># 根据向量或者主键进行分组相似性检索 + 条件过滤
ret = collection.query_group_by(
    vector=[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4],   # 向量检索，也可设置主键检索
    group_by_field='name',
    filter='age &gt; 18',             # 条件过滤，仅对age &gt; 18的Doc进行相似性检索
    output_fields=['name', 'age'], # 仅返回name、age这2个Field
    include_vector=True
)
</code></pre>
<h3 id="带有sparse-vector的分组向量检索">带有Sparse Vector的分组向量检索</h3>
<p>Python示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"># 根据向量进行分组相似性检索 + 稀疏向量
ret = collection.query_group_by(
    vector=[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4],   # 向量检索
    sparse_vector={1: 0.3, 20: 0.7},
    group_by_field='name',
)
</code></pre>

</div>
